# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The tests that are not one project's (planning/monorepo.md, (e)). Each library's own are in
# libs/<lib>/tests and each program's beside it (apps/<product>/<program>/tests), a binary each,
# added by the root CMakeLists.txt after this directory; this one holds what every binary is built
# with (support/, iclforge::test_support) and iclforge-perf. Golden vectors under golden/ are
# generated by the scripts in tools/ (see their headers).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_subdirectory(support)
include(IclforgeTests)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# iclforge-perf - real-time throughput regression guards, deliberately a SEPARATE
# binary/target from the test binaries rather than a couple more source files added to
# one. A throughput assertion is a different kind of check from the rest of
# the suite: environment-sensitive (see test_performance.cpp's ASan slack),
# meant to be read as a number as much as a pass/fail, and not something a
# quick correctness-only run (`ctest -E Performance`, say) should have to
# carry. Catch2 is resolved by the root CMakeLists.txt (cmake/External.cmake); this target reuses it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_subdirectory(performance)
